name: Laravel backend production audit
prompt: Audit this Laravel 12 app for Eloquent, Form Requests, policies, queues, jobs, migrations, tenant scoping, webhooks, PHPStan/Pint, and production performance.

name: Nuxt SSR SEO performance audit
prompt: Audit this Nuxt 4 frontend for SSR, Nitro, useFetch, useAsyncData, hydration, route rules, metadata, sitemap, and Core Web Vitals.

name: VPS Docker deployment hardening
prompt: Deploy Laravel and Nuxt on a VPS using Docker Compose, Nginx/Caddy reverse proxy, SSL, Redis, database volume, backup, rollback, firewall, and health checks.

name: SQL schema and partial unique index review
prompt: Review this MariaDB MySQL PostgreSQL SQLite schema for constraints, soft delete uniqueness, partial indexes, composite indexes, safe migrations, and EXPLAIN query plans.

name: MongoDB document model review
prompt: Review this MongoDB design for document shape, compound indexes, aggregation pipeline, schema validation, write concern, and unbounded arrays.

name: Redis cache queue incident review
prompt: Review Redis cache invalidation, tenant scoped cache keys, Laravel queue workers, Horizon, failed jobs, locks, rate limits, timeout, retry_after, TTL, and eviction policy.

name: Humanized UI UX design audit
prompt: Audit this UI UX so it does not look AI generated. Check responsive design, accessibility, visual hierarchy, empty state, loading state, error state, copy, and mobile-first behavior.

name: Application security threat model
prompt: Security audit this app for OWASP, STRIDE, broken access control, auth, tenant isolation, secrets, PII, webhook replay, dependency CVE, logging, and incident rollback.

name: SEO GEO landing page audit
prompt: Audit this landing page for SEO and GEO: search intent, answer engine optimization, schema, internal linking, canonical URL, sitemap, metadata, FAQ, and citeable claims.

name: 90 day marketing content calendar
prompt: Create a 90 days content calendar for Malaysian audience with Malay English tone, hooks, CTA, content pillars, Threads posts, TikTok scripts, vendor and customer segments, and metrics.

name: Sales GTM strategy review
prompt: Act as my cofounder and review our B2B sales strategy: ICP, lead qualification, outreach, objection handling, pricing, proposal, pipeline, CRM, close plan, and success metrics.

name: Expert cofounder repo audit
prompt: Audit this cofounder agent and tell me if it is expert in Nuxt, Laravel, Docker, VPS deployment, MariaDB, MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, performance, UI UX, security, SEO GEO, marketing, sales, and content calendar.

name: SaaS billing operations
prompt: Review our SaaS subscription lifecycle with failed payment dunning, invoices, receipts, plan upgrades, cancellation, recurring billing, entitlement gating, and refund edge cases.

name: Tenant isolation security
prompt: A user from Acme sees rows that belong to BetaCorp. Audit this multi tenant organization scoping and cross-tenant data leak risk.

name: Observability SRE
prompt: Set up production observability with logs, metrics, tracing, health checks, alerts, SLO, dashboard, and incident runbook for our Laravel SaaS.

name: QA automation strategy
prompt: Create a QA automation strategy using Playwright, Cypress, PHPUnit, feature tests, fixtures, regression suite, and CI test gate.

name: Malaysia PDPA privacy
prompt: Review Malaysia PDPA privacy for personal data, consent notice, retention, processor vendors, user deletion/export, and cross border transfer.

name: Cost optimization
prompt: Reduce our cloud, server, model token budget, LLM API cost, queue worker spend, and storage bill without hurting critical quality.

name: Customer success support
prompt: Build customer success SOP for onboarding, support tickets, escalation, retention, churn, FAQ, feedback loop, and CSAT.

name: Prompt injection defense
prompt: Harden our AI agent against prompt injection, memory poisoning, untrusted documents, tool abuse, least privilege, and secret exfiltration.

name: Eval driven agent improvement
prompt: Improve BosskuAI with routing evals, retrieval benchmarks, LLM quality cases, token budget scoring, golden cases, and regression harness.
